几分钟后，袁红推开门进来。

见到好兄弟，胡哥赶紧拉着介绍：“老袁，这是我们上戏的学弟魏沐。”

“你好你好。”

袁红笑着点头，眼神在魏沐和刘施施的身上游移。

不得不说，这么一看，这俩人确实挺像一对。

用老话说，这叫夫妻相。

打完招呼，众人落座，魏沐和袁红胡哥聊起来。

这三人都是上戏学生，有不少共同话题。

“谷老师还是跟以前一样骂人吗？”

“没有，老师对我不错，从不骂人。”

“那是你出名！！”

袁红深有感触，他上学的时候没少被谷一安骂，导致后来回学校都有些怕见到对方。

至于胡哥，比他好不了多少，他们两个属于毕业以后成名，根本没享受到学校明星的快乐。

魏沐享受到一点，但不多，他还有两个月就要毕业，顶多身为优秀毕业生上去演讲。

三个大男人聊的热火朝天，让身为组局者的刘施施感觉受到冷落。

她亲手把后辈带进来，必须要多说两句。

“咳咳。”

她清了清嗓子，想要吸引注意力。

结果只有郭小婷这个小妹妹睁着大眼睛看过来。

“诗诗姐，怎么了？”

另外三个男人还在聊天.....

刘施施不爽了，什么意思，我说话这么没有分量？

还有魏沐，忘记是谁把你带进来的吗？太不把前辈放在眼里！！

于是又一声轻咳响起。

“我说个事。”

“老魏后面可能会来我们公司。”

这句话让袁红大脑当机，他缓缓转头看向坐在身边的学弟，后者没有否定。

魏沐要来唐人？

我靠，刘施施要玩灯下黑啊。

平常怎么没看出来这女孩这么厉害，胆子真大！！

这就是新人王的实力吗？

其实从刘施施刚进公司，袁红就感到老板蔡怡农对她多有照顾。

不仅让对方住自己家里，还给了她不少资源。

后者还好说，毕竟公司真正的女艺人只有施施一个，郭小婷年纪太小不算。

但前者就很耐人寻味。

反正从他加入公司起，袁红就没见老板对谁这么好过。

“确定了？”

这次开口的是胡哥。

“老胡，你早就知道？”

袁红心口又被扎了一刀，原来就我一人不知道。

A few minutes later, Yuan Hong opened the door and came in.

When he saw his good brother, Brother Hu quickly introduced him: "Lao Yuan, this is our junior fellow student Wei Mu who is on stage."

"Hello hello."

Yuan Hong smiled and nodded, her eyes wandering on Wei Mu and Liu Shishi.

I have to say, at first glance, these two people do look like a couple.

In the old saying, this is called husband and wife appearance.

After saying hello, everyone sat down and Wei Mu chatted with Yuan Hong and Brother Hu.

These three are all theater students and have many things in common.

"Teacher Gu, are you still cursing as before?"

"No, the teacher is nice to me and never scolds me."

"That's why you're famous!!"

Yuan Hong was deeply touched. When he was in school, he was often scolded by Gu Yian, which made him a little afraid of seeing him when he went back to school.

As for Brother Hu, he is not much better than him. The two of them became famous after graduation and did not enjoy the happiness of school stars at all.

Wei Mu enjoyed it a little, but not much. He was going to graduate in two months. At most, he could give a speech as an outstanding graduate.

The three grown men chatted animatedly, making Liu Shishi, the organizer of the game, feel left out.

She brought the younger generation in with her own hands and had to say a few words.

"Ahem."

She cleared her throat, trying to attract attention.

In the end, only the little sister Guo Xiaoting looked over with her big eyes open.

"Sister Shishi, what's wrong?"

The other three men are still chatting...

Liu Shishi was upset. What do you mean, my words are so weightless?

And Wei Mu, have you forgotten who brought you here?You don’t take your seniors seriously!!

Then another light cough sounded.

"Let me tell you something."

"Lao Wei may come to our company later."

This sentence made Yuan Hong's brain freeze. He slowly turned his head to look at the junior student sitting next to him, who did not deny it.

Wei Mu is coming to Tangren?

Damn it, Liu Shishi wants to play in the dark.

Why don't I usually see that this girl is so powerful and so courageous!!

Is this the strength of the new king?

In fact, from the moment Liu Shishi entered the company, Yuan Hong felt that her boss Cai Yinong took good care of her.

Not only did he let the other party live in his home, he also gave her a lot of resources.

The latter is okay, after all, the only real female artist in the company is Shi Shi, and Guo Xiaoting is too young to count.

But the former is very intriguing.

Anyway, since he joined the company, Yuan Hong has never seen his boss treat anyone so kindly.

"Are you sure?"

It was Brother Hu who spoke this time.

"Lao Hu, you already knew this?"

Yuan Hong was stabbed in the heart again, and it turned out that I was the only one who didn’t know.
